instruction: `C:\Users\user\Desktop\stackup.json` contains the 6-layer stackup description in which each layer has `index`, `name`, and `type`, where `type` is `Signal`, `GND`, or `PWR`. The opened file `template.OutJob` is an empty OutJob containing only `[OutputJobFile]` and an empty `[OutputGroup1]`. Generate one `OutputType=Gerber` output inside `[OutputGroup1]` for each stackup layer, for 6 outputs total, and write the corresponding `PlotLayerN` field for each output according to these rules: - Signal layers (`type=Signal`) map to Altium copper-layer names from top to bottom: the first signal layer becomes `TopLayer`, the last signal layer becomes `BottomLayer`, and any intermediate signal layers become `MidLayer1`, `MidLayer2`, and so on in order. - Plane layers (`type=GND` or `PWR`) all map to `Mechanical15`. To associate each output with the input stackup layer, each Gerber output must also include `StackupSourceN=<layer.name>` (for example, `StackupSource1=L1`). Other fields such as `OutputTypeN`, `OutputNameN`, `OutputCategoryN`, and `OutputEnabledN` may use any reasonable values. Write the result to `C:\Users\user\Desktop\layered.OutJob`.
